summary: Slim has been updated with a fresh new line-up: Light Brass, Brass, Gun Metal and Copper—designed to match or complement a wide range of materials, palettes and bathroom aesthetics.
title: Meet The New Slim Flush Button Finishes
bodyHtml:
New Slim PVD on Stainless Steel - Gun Metal

The Slim Plate gets a Glow-Up

Our top-selling Slim Flush Plate is now available in a considered selection of PVD-finished stainless steel, expanding versatility of design in one of our most specified flush plates.

The fresh new line-up includes Light Brass, Brass, Gun Metal and Copper—designed to match or complement a wide range of materials, palettes and bathroom aesthetics.


Slim in Brass - PVD on Stainless Steel

An Architectural Favourite

Slim’s minimalist lines make it a favourite among architects and designers, offering a restrained or impactful presence on the wall depending on your design scheme.


Slim in Copper

Crafted in Portugal by Oli

Made by Oli, Southern Europe’s largest Cistern and Flush Plate manufacturer — Slim is the result of decades of precision engineering and a commitment to design integrity. With a legacy dating back to 1954, Oli products are defined by rigorous performance testing, aesthetic versatility, and European craftsmanship.

The new PVD finishes join a timeless core range of Matte Black, Matte White, Satin Chrome and Brushed Stainless Steel.


Oli - Cistern & Flush Button manufacturers since 1954

Sustainable by Design

Behind the wall, Oli in-wall cisterns are engineered for efficiency. Each unit includes a unique delayed refill valve, reducing water consumption by approximately half a litre with every flush.

This forward-thinking innovation delivers tangible environmental benefits and long-term water savings—without compromising flush performance or reliability.


Oli - Cistern & Flush Button manufacturers since 1954
